instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Nova is a grassroots organization focused on improving maternal and child health outcomes through localized vaccination campaigns and essential nutrition support in dense urban areas. The current operations rely heavily on community trust and high-touch service delivery, which necessitates efficient logistics but limits scalability.
answers.pastInitiatives: The organization has historically focused entirely on maintaining core programs and managing immediate operational needs without formal innovation cycles or dedicated R&D efforts. System modernization is currently treated as an urgent operational fix rather than a strategic growth initiative, resulting in no documented systematic transformation.
answers.strategicGoals: The board has mandated that 25% of revenue should come from products or services that did not exist 3 years ago. This requires us to systematically explore adjacent markets, new customer segments, and alternative monetization models beyond traditional grant funding.
answers.additionalContext: The organization is highly sensitive to public perception and relies on donor goodwill, meaning any technology rollout must be deeply integrated with community values.
answers.teamSize: We have 2 generalist developers who split their time between maintaining our existing systems, handling customer support escalations, and occasionally prototyping new features. There is no dedicated innovation or R&D role — innovation happens when these developers have spare cycles between urgent operational tasks, which is rare.

opportunities.title: Automated Patient Adherence Tools (Mobile)
opportunities.rationale: Developing and piloting a low-cost mobile tracking app for immunization schedules can streamline data collection and reduce human error in follow-ups, increasing program efficiency.

first_actions: Conduct a 1-week feasibility study on existing health data integration APIs.
Identify 3 key community partners willing to pilot the system.
resources_needed: 20 hours contractor time for MVP development
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve a 15% reduction in missed appointment reminders within the pilot group.
milestones: Q3: Finalize UI/UX design and prototype completion.
Q4: Launch small-scale pilot with 50 patients.

opportunities.title: Community Health Data Licensing Platform
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging anonymized, aggregated local health data to create a proprietary, compliant API service for private wellness providers or insurance companies presents a major diversification avenue.

first_actions: Engage legal counsel specializing in data monetization agreements.
Establish secure, compliant data anonymization protocols.
resources_needed: Consultant fee for regulatory compliance review
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure 1 Letter of Intent (LOI) from one external B2B partner.
milestones: Q3: Complete legal framework and anonymization standards.

next_steps.action: Appoint a dedicated, part-time 'Innovation Steward' (internal role or fractional consultant) to define the innovation roadmap and manage small pilot budgets.

Form an ad-hoc 'Technology Exploration Task Force' composed of staff members with existing development/operational experience to evaluate the feasibility of external advisory support for complex technology vetting.

key_weaknesses: Lack of formalized innovation process leading to inconsistent resource allocation and initiative failure.
Over-reliance on owner decision-making which hinders necessary external expertise sourcing for high-complexity projects.
Severe talent gap in specialized technical skills required for modernizing existing operational systems and scaling digital solutions.
